system.description:
Magic-User or Illusionist only. 6' cylindrical black metal pole with 3 ring indentations, an indicator arrow, and a triangular headpiece socket.

  • Bare Staff: +1 magic weapon (1d6+1).
  • + Ring of Embarkation: +2 magic weapon; casts Magic Missile, Light, and Knock (1/day each at 4th caster level).
  • + Ring of Destination: +3 magic weapon; also casts Detect Invisibility, Ray of Enfeeblement, and Protection from Normal Missiles (1/day each at 5th caster level).
  • + Power Ring & Headpiece: Unlocks Hengegate teleportation and Power Ring spells.
